label: Legal basis
value: Provinces legislate on direct taxation within the province and on municipal institutions (Constitution Act, 1867, s. 92(2) and (8)); municipal and school property taxes rest on provincial law and are listed on each province's page
note: Property taxes are set locally on assessed value. British Columbia also has a provincial speculation and vacancy tax; see the provincial pages.
source_title: Constitution Act, 1867, s. 92 (Justice Laws Website)

label: Federal Underused Housing Tax
value: None for 2025 and later years: no tax and no return (Underused Housing Tax Act s. 1.1, 6.1); the annual 1% tax still applies to 2022 to 2024
note: Property taxes are set locally on assessed value. British Columbia also has a provincial speculation and vacancy tax; see the provincial pages.
source_title: Underused Housing Tax Act, s. 1.1 and s. 6.1 (current to 2026-10-19, last amended 2026-03-26); CRA: Underused Housing Tax (page details 2025-04-04)
